entries.title: John 16:1
segments: ¶I have said these things to you so that you may not be in doubt.

entries.title: John 16:2
segments: They will put you out of the Synagogues: yes, the time is coming when whoever puts you to death will have the belief that he is doing God's pleasure.

entries.title: John 16:3
segments: They will do these things to you because they have not had knowledge of the Father or of me.

entries.title: John 16:4
segments: I have said these things to you so that when the time comes, what I have said may come to your mind. I did not say them to you at the first, because then I was still with you.

entries.title: John 16:5
segments: But now I am going to him who sent me; and not one of you says to me, Where are you going?

entries.title: John 16:6
segments: But your hearts are full of sorrow because I have said these things.

entries.title: John 16:7
segments: ¶But what I am saying is true: my going is for your good: for if I do not go away, the Helper will not come to you; but if I go, I will send him to you.

entries.title: John 16:8
segments: And he, when he comes, will make the world conscious of sin, and of righteousness, and of being judged:

entries.title: John 16:9
segments: Of sin, because they have not faith in me;

entries.title: John 16:10
segments: Of righteousness, because I go to the Father and you will see me no more;

entries.title: John 16:11
segments: Of being judged, because the ruler of this world has been judged.

entries.title: John 16:12
segments: I have still much to say to you, but you are not strong enough for it now.

entries.title: John 16:13
segments: However, when he, the Spirit of true knowledge, has come, he will be your guide into all true knowledge: for his words will not come from himself, but whatever has come to his hearing, that he will say: and he will make clear to you the things to come.

entries.title: John 16:14
segments: He will give me glory, because he will take of what is mine, and make it clear to you.

entries.title: John 16:15
segments: Everything which the Father has is mine: that is why I say, He will take of what is mine and will make it clear to you.

entries.title: John 16:16
segments: ¶After a little time you will see me no longer; and then again, after a little time, you will see me.

entries.title: John 16:17
segments: So some of the disciples said one to another, What is this he is saying, After a little time, you will see me no longer; and then again, after a little time, you will see me? and, I am going to the Father?

entries.title: John 16:18
segments: So they said again and again, What is this he is saying, A little time? His words are not clear to us.

entries.title: John 16:19
segments: Jesus saw that they had a desire to put the question to him, so he said to them, Is this what you are questioning one with another, why I said, After a little time, you will see me no longer; and then again, after a little time, you will see me?

entries.title: John 16:20
segments: Truly I say to you, You will be weeping and sorrowing, but the world will be glad: you will be sad, but your sorrow will be turned into joy.

entries.title: John 16:21
segments: When a woman is about to give birth she has sorrow, because her hour is come; but when she has given birth to the child, the pain is put out of her mind by the joy that a man has come into the world.

entries.title: John 16:22
segments: So you have sorrow now: but I will see you again, and your hearts will be glad, and no one will take away your joy.

entries.title: John 16:23
segments: ¶And on that day you will put no questions to me. Truly I say to you, Whatever request you make to the Father, he will give it to you in my name.

entries.title: John 16:24
segments: Up to now you have made no request in my name: do so, and it will be answered, so that your hearts may be full of joy.

entries.title: John 16:25
segments: All this I have said to you in veiled language: but the time is coming when I will no longer say things in veiled language but will give you knowledge of the Father clearly.

entries.title: John 16:26
segments: In that day you will make requests in my name: and I do not say that I will make prayer to the Father for you,

entries.title: John 16:27
segments: For the Father himself gives his love to you, because you have given your love to me and have had faith that I came from God.

entries.title: John 16:28
segments: ¶I came out from the Father and have come into the world: again, I go away from the world and go to the Father.

entries.title: John 16:29
segments: His disciples said, Now you are talking clearly and not in veiled language.

entries.title: John 16:30
segments: Now we are certain that you have knowledge of all things and have no need for anyone to put questions to you: through this we have faith that you came from God.

entries.title: John 16:31
segments: Jesus made answer, Have you faith now?

entries.title: John 16:32
segments: See, a time is coming, yes, it is now here, when you will go away in all directions, every man to his house, and I will be by myself: but I am not by myself, because the Father is with me.

entries.title: John 16:33
segments: I have said all these things to you so that in me you may have peace. In the world you have trouble: but take heart! I have overcome the world.
